_comment: FC 26's identity and module list, read by scripts/game_config.py (the Makefile, the scripts and the tests take them from here). Facts from games/fc26/docs/BRIEFING.md, measured 2026-10-22: base game 1.0.0, no update and no DLC; ExeFS main, sdk, rtld, main.npdm and no subsdk0. modules: what the runtime maps, relocates and initialises, in that order (main first: the probe calls main's PLT and boot reports offsets in main); each one is rewritten to rewritten/<version_dir>/<name>.patched.bin. analysis_modules: what prepare_modules.py turns into analysis ELF.
